exposure: in vitro fertilization cycles with both oocyte and sperm donation (double donation; DD)
cohort: 1139 women receiving in vitro fertilization cycles with both oocyte and sperm donation (double donation; DD)
finding: No significant differences in clinical outcomes (biochemical pregnancy, clinical pregnancy, live birth, multiple birth, and cesarean section rates) were observed among single women, women with a male partner, and women with a female partner undergoing DD cycles.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates did not differ among single women and women with male or female partners undergoing double donation IVF.
